ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels with sparse high-intensity (white) punctate disruptions across approximately 95% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark substrate (black). Scattered, high-contrast white focal spots (<5px diameter) distributed semi-randomly, with higher density clusters near the median notch and lower-central regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch; calculated internal angle of approximately 130 degrees with a central depth significantly less than the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern. The right lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, low-amplitude (2-5px) sharp peaks. The left lobe trailing edge displays lower frequency, more rounded topographic variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal sweep beginning with a concave curve at the median notch and transitioning to a broad convex curve extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters (5-12px) visible; most prominent on the interior left lobe and scattered along the leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal white linear mark (~50px) on the right lobe; several shorter, less distinct linear marks (10-20px) on the upper left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular, textured growth or mass attached to the extreme distal tip of the right lobe lobe; distinct notch/depression on the left trailing edge at approximately 30% distance from the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density cluster of micro-punctate white spots localized at the peduncle insertion point (bottom center).
